inventory-packing.context: An online sales team with several packers and customer-service staff processes daily orders from two marketplaces.
inventory-packing.problem: Orders, stock, and packing were managed in many spreadsheets: separate tabs per packer, packing recaps, and stock notes built by hand. It was hard to see which goods to prepare that day, which SKUs were running low, and who was working on which order.
inventory-packing.solution: A multi-tenant inventory platform. Orders arrive through a marketplace API or a CSV/Excel import, the system builds the day's goods requirement and splits orders across packers, and each packer receives a digital packing sheet on their phone. Stock drops automatically when packing is confirmed through a mutation log that is never edited, stock status (safe, careful, use up, empty) is calculated automatically, and each seller's data is isolated with row-level security.

content-partner-platform.context: A team that manages marketplace affiliate creators needs one place for products, tutorial material, and the webinar schedule.
content-partner-platform.solution: A role-based web app with three modules: products, tutorials (with learning-progress tracking), and a webinar schedule (with attendance records). Two-layer login: internal accounts through OAuth and creators through an ID and password, with row-level security for three roles. Two n8n workflows fetch product images automatically and send a daily webinar reminder.
